summary: A 44-year-old Montrose man reported missing in the Erickson Springs area was located safe the next day by a search and rescue team; he said he deviated from his planned route after encountering a bear and her cubs.
responding_agency: Gunnison County Sheriff's Office; search and rescue team
notes: Per-incident one-liner from the Gunnison County Sheriff's Office weekly press release (May 28, 2018 edition). Mined run 463.
